ottohubauth-desc: Log in to OTTOWiki with an OTTOhub account (stage 1)
ottohubauth-field-account-help: Log in to OTTOWiki with your OTTOhub account. No OTTOhub account yet? Register at https://www.ottohub.cn/ first.
ottohubauth-field-password-help: The password is used only to verify your identity with OTTOhub and is never stored by OTTOWiki.
ottohubauth-error-empty: Please fill in both the OTTOhub account and password.
ottohubauth-error-throttled: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
ottohubauth-error-upstream-throttled: OTTOhub reports too many attempts. Please try again later.
ottohubauth-error-unavailable: OTTOhub is temporarily unavailable. Users who already have a local OTTOWiki password can still log in with it.
ottohubauth-error-identity: OTTOhub returned an inconsistent identity, so this login was aborted for safety. Please retry; contact an administrator if this keeps happening.
ottohubauth-error-session: Your login session is invalid. Please log in again.
ottohubauth-error-autocreate: Could not create the account automatically: $1.
ottohubauth-error-username-invalid: Could not derive a valid OTTOWiki username from your OTTOhub username. Please contact an administrator.
ottohubauth-error-link-conflict: That OTTOhub identity or that local account is already linked, so it cannot be linked again.
ottohubauth-error-account-vanished: The target account no longer exists. Please log in again.
ottohubauth-error-bad-token: This form expired (security token mismatch). Please submit it again.
ottohubauth-claim-intro: OTTOWiki already has an account named "$1", which matches your OTTOhub username "$2". Please confirm whether this is you:
ottohubauth-claim-checkbox: This is my account; link it
ottohubauth-claim-checkbox-help: An OTTOhub username is only a hint, not proof (anyone can register the same name). Linking requires the local password of that OTTOWiki account.
ottohubauth-claim-password: Local password of that OTTOWiki account
ottohubauth-claim-password-help: The OTTOhub password you entered earlier cannot replace this; enter the password you used to log in to OTTOWiki before.
ottohubauth-claim-wrong-password: That local password is incorrect, so ownership could not be proven. You may retry, or uncheck the box and create a new account instead.
ottohubauth-claim-not-mine-note: If you leave the box unchecked, a new account will be created for you under OTTOWiki naming rules (the other account's edit history and rights are not transferred).
ottohubauth-disable-local-password-label: Disable the OTTOWiki local password after linking
ottohubauth-disable-local-password-help:
Left unchecked by default.
'''Benefit''': only one set of credentials remains (OTTOhub), so OTTOWiki no longer keeps a second password that could be leaked or credential-stuffed; after you change your OTTOhub password, no old OTTOWiki password lingers as a back door.
'''Risk''': once disabled, you '''cannot log in to OTTOWiki''' while OTTOhub is down or under maintenance (no local fallback); if your OTTOhub account is lost or stolen, only an administrator can restore access.
'''Reversible''': you can set a local password again at any time in Special:Preferences (as long as you can still log in via OTTOhub).
'''Note''': leaving it unchecked only means "nothing changes now" — the switch in Preferences stays available and you can disable it later.
ottohubauth-register-intro: OTTOWiki now uses '''OTTOhub accounts''' for login, and local self-registration is closed.
ottohubauth-register-steps:
How to get in:
# If you do not have an OTTOhub account yet, register one at https://www.ottohub.cn/.
# Come back here and log in with your OTTOhub account (username or email) and password.
# Your first login creates the OTTOWiki account automatically. If your OTTOhub username matches an existing local account, you will be asked to "claim" it by entering that local account's password to prove ownership.
ottohubauth-register-faq:
'''Frequently asked questions'''
; I do not have an OTTOhub account. What now?
: Register one for free at https://www.ottohub.cn/, then come back and log in here.
; I already have an OTTOWiki account but it is not linked to OTTOhub.
: Log in with your existing local password, then complete a one-time link at Special:LinkOttohub. Afterwards you can log in with OTTOhub, and you can still use your local password unless you disable it.
; Will linking affect my edit history or rights?
: No. Linking only records the mapping between your OTTOhub identity and your local account; when you claim your own account, edit history and user groups are left untouched.
ottohubauth-reset-blocked: This account has no OTTOWiki local password (accounts created through OTTOhub login have none by default), so email-based reset is not possible. Please log in with your OTTOhub account; once logged in you can set a local password in Special:Preferences.
ottohubauth-pref-link-help: Once linked you can log in to this wiki with your OTTOhub account. Re-linking requires an administrator.
ottohubauth-pref-password-status-on: Status: the local password is '''enabled''', so you can log directly into OTTOWiki with a local password.
ottohubauth-pref-password-disable-help: Once disabled you cannot log in to OTTOWiki while OTTOhub is down or under maintenance, and there is no self-service recovery — only an administrator can restore access. The benefit is that the wiki no longer stores a second set of credentials that could be leaked or credential-stuffed. **This cannot be undone by yourself**: contact an administrator if you need a local password again.
ottohubauth-pref-password-disabled: The local password has been disabled; please log in with your OTTOhub account.
ottohubauth-pref-password-bad-token: Security token mismatch; the action was not performed.
ottohubauth-link-require-login: Please log in first, then link your OTTOhub account.
ottohubauth-link-intro: This page links an OTTOhub identity to the local account '''$1'''. It only handles the first link; contact an administrator to re-link or unlink.
ottohubauth-link-already-linked: The local account '''$1''' is already linked to OTTOhub. An administrator must re-link or unlink it at Special:OttohubAccounts.
ottohubauth-link-admin-note: (Policy D11: self-service re-linking is not offered, to prevent account takeover.)
ottohubauth-link-success: Linked successfully: local account '''$1''' ↔ OTTOhub '''$2''' (OTTOhub UID $3).
ottohubauth-link-taken: That OTTOhub identity is already linked to another local account and cannot be linked again. Please contact an administrator.
ottohubauth-accounts-intro: View, unlink or re-link a user's OTTOhub identity, or restore a local password. Every action is recorded in Special:Log.
ottohubauth-accounts-id-warning: ⚠️ This page shows two different IDs: the '''OTTOhub UID''' belongs to OTTOhub, while the '''local user_id''' belongs to OTTOWiki. Their value ranges overlap, and a wrong value does not raise an error — it silently affects the wrong person. Compare both values shown here before submitting.
ottohubauth-accounts-bound: Linked OTTOhub: '''OTTOhub UID $1''', OTTOhub username: $2; linked by user_id $3; linked at $4
ottohubauth-accounts-not-linked: This account is not linked to OTTOhub.
ottohubauth-accounts-no-such-user: There is no local account named "$1".
ottohubauth-accounts-missing-params: Missing or malformed parameters; the action was not performed.
ottohubauth-accounts-relink-legend: Re-link to a different OTTOhub identity
ottohubauth-accounts-hubuid-help: This is the uid on the '''OTTOhub side''', not the local user_id. On submit, OTTOhub is queried first to confirm the UID exists, and its username is shown for you to verify.
ottohubauth-accounts-relinked: Re-linked local account '''$1''' (user_id $2) to OTTOhub UID $3 ($4).
ottohubauth-accounts-setpass-help: For users who cannot get into OTTOhub at all. A random temporary password is generated and shown '''only once'''; hand it over in person or through a trusted channel and ask the user to change it right after logging in.
ottohubauth-accounts-setpass-button: Generate and set a temporary password
ottohubauth-accounts-temppass: A temporary local password has been set for '''$1''' (shown only this once):
ottohubauth-accounts-temppass-advice: Write it down and hand it over immediately. It will never be shown again and is not written to any log; the user should change it in Special:Preferences soon after logging in.
log-description-ottohubauth: Administrative actions on OTTOhub links (unlink / re-link / restore local password)
logentry-ottohubauth-unlink: unlinked local account $2 from OTTOhub UID $1
logentry-ottohubauth-relink: re-linked OTTOhub UID $1 (OTTOhub username $2) to local account $3 (user_id $4)
logentry-ottohubauth-setpass: set a temporary local password for local account $1 (user_id $2)
right-ottohubauth-manage: Manage users' OTTOhub links (view / unlink / re-link / restore local password)
ottohubauth-pref-hideprofile-label: Hide the OTTOhub box on my profile page
ottohubauth-pref-hideprofile-help: Public by default: your OTTOhub avatar, username, UID and intro appear in the right column of your profile page. If you tick this, other people will not see the box (you still will). This is a display switch on the wiki side only; it does not change anything on OTTOhub and can be undone at any time. Note: while the box is visible to visitors, their browser makes one direct request to api.ottohub.cn (which reveals their IP to that service).
ottohubauth-notify-edit-user-talk: $1 left a message on your talk page.
ottohubauth-notify-social-msg-send: $1 left a message on your board.
ottohubauth-pref-notifyhint: Your OTTOhub account is linked. To also receive wiki notifications as OTTOhub direct messages, tick the relevant categories under "OTTOhub direct message" on the Notifications tab; nothing is ticked by default, so nothing is pushed. Anything pushed to your OTTOhub inbox is visible to OTTOhub and is sent by the sender account (the official account), not by the OTTOhub system node.
echo-pref-tooltip-ottohubauth-moderation: Notify me when an edit I submitted is approved.
ottohubauth-tab-local-hint: Sign in with your OTTOWiki username and local password (the original method for existing users). '''If you are new, or never set a local password, use the "OTTOhub account" tab''' - local self-registration is closed.
ottohubauth-tab-hub-hint: Sign in with your OTTOhub username or email and OTTOhub password. This is the way in for new users: your OTTOWiki account is '''created automatically''' on first sign-in. No OTTOhub account yet? Create one free at https://www.ottohub.cn/.
ottohubauth-login-faq:
'''Sign-in FAQ'''
; I am new here and have no OTTOWiki account. How do I start?
: Local self-registration is closed, and you do '''not''' need to apply for a wiki account: first create a free OTTOhub account at https://www.ottohub.cn/, then switch to the "'''OTTOhub account'''" tab above and sign in with your OTTOhub username (or email) and OTTOhub password - '''your OTTOWiki account is created automatically on your first sign-in'''. See [[Special:CreateAccount|the sign-up guide]] for the full steps.
; Which account should I use?
: Existing users can use either a '''wiki account''' (OTTOWiki username + local password) or an '''OTTOhub account''' (OTTOhub username or email + OTTOhub password); switch with the tabs above the form. The two sets of credentials are never mixed. '''New users can only use "OTTOhub account"''' (this wiki does not issue local passwords).
; I never set a local password. Can I use "Wiki account"?
: No. If your account was created automatically on your first OTTOhub sign-in, it has no local password - use the "OTTOhub account" tab. Ask an administrator if you need a local fallback password.
; After signing in with OTTOhub, why am I asked for a different password?
: Your OTTOhub username matches an existing wiki account. To avoid handing you someone else's account, the system asks for that wiki account's '''original password''' to prove it is yours (this is called claiming). If it is not your account, choose "not mine" to create a new one.
; I forgot my password.
: Wiki account: use Special:PasswordReset (works only for accounts that still have a local password). OTTOhub account: the password is managed by OTTOhub - reset it at https://www.ottohub.cn/; this wiki cannot reset it.
; OTTOhub is down or under maintenance. Can I still sign in?
: If you still have a local password, switch to "Wiki account" and sign in normally. If your local password was disabled, you must wait for OTTOhub, or ask an administrator to issue a temporary password via Special:OttohubAccounts.
; How do I link or unlink OTTOhub?
: Link it yourself at Special:LinkOttohub (you must sign in with your local password first). Ask an administrator to re-link or unlink.
